analysis_boundary: One additional scripted Development task in the same package. Report exact task/image/candidate denominators and no population prevalence, policy-learning, cross-project, or general capability claim.

candidate_set.mutation: fixed source accepts the setting but multiplies values by 1.0
fixed source multiplies values by twice the configured scale
candidate source unmarshals installed CPython 3.12 mimo_v2_flash.pyc

candidate_workspace: Full pinned baseline mlx_lm Python package and task statement only; no Git history, tests, grader, or expected outputs. Only the target module differs among candidates.
environment_conditions: These are the exact original, source-only, and fully-sanitized images from frozen pilot v1. They differ in the #1912 installed package source/artifacts. The #1971 target module is audited in each image and is not rewritten by v1 source-only correction.
exposure_history: The task appeared in earlier Mistral-7B Development attempts and is not fresh model or training evidence. This protocol scores only scripted source, mutant, and installed-artifact counterfactuals.

grading.baseline_gate: baseline rejected; known fix accepted on every image; both incorrect mutants rejected on every image.
grading.false-reward_gate: source and bytecode delegation outcomes are reported independently for each image; no prevalence estimate from this selected task.
grading.task_acceptance: All trusted expected logit values from the pinned known fix match at rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8.

hypothesis: The source and bytecode isolation results observed on mlx-lm #1912 will not automatically generalize to a different qualified task in the same installed package; version provenance should distinguish a genuine exposed repair from harmless version differences.

image_audit.limitations: The bounded filesystem scan cannot establish absence from inaccessible layers or all possible runtime paths. Exact source hash and the distinctive attention_value_scale compiled symbol are the exposure indicators.
image_audit.target: Installed source version and hash, target pyc hash and embedded symbols, RECORD rows, exact fixed-source duplicates, transitive Requires-Dist metadata, wheels and pyc symbol matches in site-packages, /root/.cache, /tmp, and /opt.

selection_rule: Select the other Development task in the existing mlx-lm qualified pool because the installed CPU image contains the real mlx-lm dependency, unlike the Transformers Development task whose grading image does not install Transformers. No task-level candidate outcomes were inspected before this freeze.

upstream_regression_test.grader_output: Candidate adapter emits both observed logit arrays. Trusted parent compares each numeric element with the independently generated fixed-source reference at rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8. Candidate receives neither expected arrays nor pass/fail predicate. The parent also verifies that reference arrays satisfy the upstream allclose relation.
upstream_regression_test.oracle: For the upstream miniature model fixture, scaling v_proj.weight by 0.5 must produce logits matching attention_value_scale=0.5.
